```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
```


```{r}
df <- read.csv("../data/ABM_results.csv")
```

```{r}
df_sub <- df[1:1000, ]
```







# distribution

```{r}
df %>%
  # filter(alpha == 3, beta == 1) %>%
  ggplot( aes(x = as.factor(gen), y = perf)) +
  geom_boxplot()
  
```


# p (probability of learning)

```{r}
df_plot <- df %>%
  group_by(gen, p) %>%
  summarise(
    perf = mean(perf),
    model_knowledge = mean(model_knowledge),
    w = mean(w)
  ) %>%
  mutate(gen = gen + 1)
```


```{r}
df_plot %>%
  ggplot( aes(x = gen, y = perf, colour = factor(p), group = p)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_text( data = . %>% filter(gen == 10), aes(label = p), hjust = -0.1, show.legend = FALSE ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0.5, 10.5),
    breaks = seq(1, 10, by = 1),
    expand = c(.001, .001)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Impact of learning probability (p)",
    y = "Task performance",
    x = "Generation",
    colour = "Probability of learning"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```


# sd (variation of learning)

```{r}
df_plot <- df %>%
  group_by(gen, sd) %>%
  summarise(
    perf = mean(perf),
    model_knowledge = mean(model_knowledge),
    w = mean(w)
  ) %>%
  mutate(gen = gen + 1)
```


```{r}
df_plot %>%
  ggplot( aes(x = gen, y = perf, colour = factor(sd), group = sd)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_text( data = . %>% filter(gen == 10), aes(label = sd), hjust = -0.1, show.legend = FALSE ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0.5, 10.5),
    breaks = seq(1, 10, by = 1),
    expand = c(.001, .001)
  ) +
  labs(

    y = "Task performance",

  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

# noise distribution

```{r}
df_plot <- df %>%
  group_by(alpha, beta) %>%
  summarise(
    perf = mean(perf),
    model_knowledge = mean(model_knowledge),
    w = mean(w)
  )
df_plot <- df_plot %>% 
  mutate(transmission_quality = alpha / (alpha + beta))
```

```{r}
df_plot %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = transmission_quality, y = perf)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth()

```


```{r}
df_plot %>%
  ggplot( aes(x = beta, y = alpha, fill = perf)) +
  geom_tile()
```



```{r}
df_plot %>%
  ggplot( aes(x = gen, y = perf)) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0.5, 10.5),
    breaks = seq(1, 10, by = 1),
    expand = c(.001, .001)
  ) +
  labs(
    y = "Task performance",
    x = "Generation"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  facet_grid(alpha ~ beta, labeller = label_both)

df_plot %>%
  ggplot( aes(x = gen, y = w)) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0.5, 10.5),
    breaks = seq(1, 10, by = 1),
    expand = c(.001, .001)
  ) +
  labs(
    y = "w",
    x = "Generation"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  facet_grid(alpha ~ beta, labeller = label_both)

df_plot %>%
  ggplot( aes(x = gen, y = model_knowledge)) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0.5, 10.5),
    breaks = seq(1, 10, by = 1),
    expand = c(.001, .001)
  ) +
  labs(
    y = "Model Knowledge",
    x = "Generation"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  facet_grid(alpha ~ beta, labeller = label_both)
```


# Lock p, alpha, beta (sd is moving)


```{r}
df_spec <- df %>%
  filter(p == 1, beta == 1, alpha == 5) %>%
  mutate(gen = gen + 1)


df_mean <- df_spec  %>%
  group_by(gen, sd) %>%
  summarise(
    perf = mean(perf),
    model_knowledge = mean(model_knowledge),
    w = mean(w)
  ) %>%
  mutate(type = "average") %>%
  mutate(sim = NA)

df_sim <- df_spec %>%
  group_by(sim, gen, sd) %>%
  summarise(
    perf = mean(perf),
    model_knowledge = mean(model_knowledge),
    w = mean(w)
  ) %>%
  mutate(type = "sim")


p_perf <- df_sim %>%
  ggplot( aes(x = gen, y = perf, group = sim)) +
  geom_line(alpha=0.6, color = "grey", size = 0.8) +
  geom_line(data = df_mean, aes(x = gen, y = perf), size = 2) +
  labs(
    x = "Generation",
    y = "Task Performance",
    shape = " ",
    colour = " "
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0.5, 10.5),
    breaks = seq(1, 10, by = 1),
    expand = c(.001, .001)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(-0.5, 1.5),
    breaks = seq(-0.5, 1.5, by = 0.50),
    expand = c(.001, .001)
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  facet_wrap(~sd, ncol = 5)


p_model_knowledge <- df_sim %>%
  ggplot( aes(x = gen, y = model_knowledge, group = sim)) +
  geom_line(alpha=0.6, color = "grey", size = 0.8) +
  geom_line(data = df_mean, aes(x = gen, y = model_knowledge), size = 2) +
  labs(
    x = "Generation",
    y = "Model Knowledge",
    shape = " ",
    colour = " "
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0.5, 10.5),
    breaks = seq(1, 10, by = 1),
    expand = c(.001, .001)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2),
    expand = c(.001, .001)
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  facet_wrap(~sd, ncol = 5)


p_w <- df_sim %>%
  ggplot( aes(x = gen, y = w, group = sim)) +
  geom_line(alpha=0.6, color = "grey", size = 0.8) +
  geom_line(data = df_mean, aes(x = gen, y = w), size = 2) +
  labs(
    x = "Generation",
    y = "W",
    shape = " ",
    colour = " "
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0.5, 10.5),
    breaks = seq(1, 10, by = 1),
    expand = c(.001, .001)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2),
    expand = c(.001, .001)
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  facet_wrap(~sd, ncol = 5)


#p_perf + p_model_knowledge / p_w
p_perf
p_model_knowledge
p_w
```

  ) %>%

  ) +

p_w <- df_sim %>%
